page_title: ARS 3-0 BOU | Arsenal v Bournemouth 04/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, David Coote has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' 3 - 0 Declan Rice (Arsenal) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low in the middle of the goal.
90+5' David Coote shows a yellow card to Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) for his blatant foul.
90+2' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90+2' Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bournemouth, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+1' David Coote blows his whistle. Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) commits a foul after dangerous play.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Andoni Iraola has decided to substitute Justin Kluivert and he is replaced by Romain Faivre (Bournemouth).
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth) comes onto the pitch so that Adam Smith can be given a rest.
87' The attendance for today's match is 60348.
87' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Gabriel (Arsenal) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
86' Mikel Arteta decides to make a substitution. Bukayo Saka will be replaced by Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal).
84' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
83' A cross from Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
81' It will be a substitution. Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) is ready to enter the pitch as Leandro Trossard walks off.
81' Flag up against Kai Havertz (Arsenal). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
80' Here is a change. Marcos Senesi is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Enes Unal (Bournemouth).
78' Good chance! Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
76' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The Bournemouth players look gutted.
75' Possible change! There could be a foul by the attacking team in the lead up. Referee David Coote wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
73' Goal disallowed! Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) scores but David Coote blows his whistle for a foul.
71' Substitution. Philip Billing (Bournemouth) has come on for Alex Scott.
70' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Declan Rice laid the ball off to Leandro Trossard (Arsenal), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
68' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
67' The resulting corner from Declan Rice (Arsenal) comes to nothing.

66' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
65' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
63' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
62' Bournemouth win a direct free kick in a dangerous mid-range position.
62' Gabriel (Arsenal) jumps into a tackle and David Coote signals a foul.
62' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
60' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
60' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
59' What was Thomas Partey (Arsenal) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
59' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
58' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
57' Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
57' The ball rebounds outside of the penalty area and falls to Alex Scott (Bournemouth) who directs his shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper is there to stop his effort.
56' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
54' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) passes the ball onto Bukayo Saka, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
54' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but David Raya pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
52' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom right corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!

49' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Mark Travers guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
47' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) commits a foul and David Coote immediately signals a free kick.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' 1 - 0 Goal! Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Mark Travers to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
45' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is going to take the penalty!
44' Referee David Coote is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Arsenal!
43' Celebrations by Arsenal are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
42' David Coote blows his whistle after Mark Travers (Bournemouth) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. The referee makes the call - penalty to Arsenal!
40' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) serves up a nice cross, but Mark Travers punches the ball away.
38' The ball finds it way to Declan Rice (Arsenal) inside the box and his first-time shot flies a whisker past the right post.
37' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is flagged for offside.
35' Leandro Trossard received a sweet pass from Martin Odegaard (Arsenal), but the advance is stopped.
34' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is penalised for a foul. David Coote had a clear view and blows his whistle.
32' The ball is cleared after Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
29' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Arsenal, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
28' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
27' A snap shot by Thomas Partey (Arsenal) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Mark Travers produces a good save to thwart him.
25' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Kai Havertz (Arsenal).
24' The linesman raises his flag. Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is adjudged offside.
23' Thomas Partey (Arsenal) wins the ball inside the goal area from the resulting set piece and unleashes a shot which sails high over the bar.
22' Arsenal will look to take advantage of a free kick in a promising position in the middle of the field.
21' The booking goes to Alex Scott (Bournemouth).
20' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal), but it's just wide of the right post.
20' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
20' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) shows good awareness inside the box, but his attempt is stopped by the goalkeeper.
19' A fine pass finds William Saliba (Arsenal) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Mark Travers reacts superbly to deny him.
18' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
18' Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
17' The total number of attempts is 7:1.
16' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

14' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Mark Travers shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
13' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
13' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is able to continue to play.
12' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
12' The game is interrupted now, Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
10' Wow, what an escape. Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
9' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
8' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
8' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
7' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
7' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
6' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
6' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
5' A pass by Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
4' Arsenal keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.

1' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) commits a rough challenge and David Coote blows his whistle for an infringement. A mid-range free kick is awarded to Bournemouth out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
